title: arn-gen release-note configuration
description: All keys are optional: omit them to use their defaults. Explicit null values are not allowed. The CLI also accepts keys in any letter case, but this schema validates the canonical camelCase names.

frontmatter.description: Go template rendered as Markdown after the release title. {{ .Title }} is available.

backmatter.description: Go template rendered as Markdown after the categories. {{ .Title }} is available.

commitPattern.description: Go regular expression applied to subject + optional blank line + body. Capture names must be unique.

ignoreUnmatchedCommits.description: Skip commits that do not match commitPattern instead of reporting an error.

excludedPatterns.description: Regular expressions matched against the full commit message; any match excludes the commit.

itemTitleTemplate.description: Go template for the item title. Must not be empty.

itemBodyTemplate.description: Go template for the item content. Must not be empty.

sectionHeaderLevel.description: Base Markdown heading level of category sections; +1 per category depth.

itemHeaderLevel.description: Base Markdown heading level of items; +1 per category depth.

uncategorizedTitle.description: Title of the section for commits matching no category. Must be a non-empty single line, unique among category names.

categoryCaseInsensitive.description: Ignore case in category patterns at every depth.

categories.description: Sibling categories are tried in order; children before the parent. Names must be unique across the whole tree.

name.description: Non-empty single line, unique across the whole tree.

patterns.description: Regular expressions; optional when the category has subcategories, in which case they act as a fallback.
